title: Utility Line Protection Plans: Customer Approval of Permanent Exterior Line Work
content:
# Customer Approval of Permanent Exterior Line Work

Approval desk reference for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans, exterior service lines.

## What the payment is

The exterior permanent-work payment is what Bridgewell pays toward the permanent repair or replacement of a covered exterior water service line, sewer lateral, septic line, electrical service line or gas service line when the contractor's quote for that work is above what Bridgewell pays; the customer approves the work in person and pays the contractor the rest of the quote, and the payment is booked as one repair authorization that records the contractor's quote as its cost.

The exterior permanent-work payment is not fixed until the service request carries the public-way restoration entry owed where that work opens a public sidewalk, curb or street. Before the exterior permanent-work payment is worked out, the service request must carry the landscaping restoration entry owed where that work is dug by open trench through the yard.

For permanent work on an exterior line whose contractor quote is above the exterior permanent-work payment, the amount paid is the exterior permanent-work payment, and only for such work; every other authorization remains under the base rule that it pays the lower of its invoice amount and the remaining occurrence benefit.

## Effect on the claim record

The approval adds one repair authorization to the service request's claim history under a new authorization number, dated the day it is approved, recording the line, the kind of work, the method, the contractor's quoted cost and the amount Bridgewell pays. By approving, the customer accepts paying the contractor directly any part of the quote above Bridgewell's payment.

## Invoking the tool

The tool is `approve_exterior_line_work_7ea09e9b`. It is the customer's own tool: the representative unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to approve the work.

### Parameters

- `customer_id` — the customer reference number of the plan holder, as read out to the customer by the representative from the customer profile lookup.
- `lineplan_contract_id` — the line protection plan number the service request belongs to, as read out by the representative from the plan lookup.
- `lineplan_service_request_id` — the line service request number the work is approved on, as read out by the representative from the service request lookup.
- `line_type` — the line named on that service request, copied from the request record. One of:
  - `water_service_line` — the exterior water service line from the utility connection to the home
  - `sewer_lateral` — the exterior sewer lateral from the home to the public sewer connection
  - `septic_line` — the exterior line from the home to the septic tank
  - `electrical_service_line` — the exterior electrical service line and meter base
  - `interior_supply_line` — water supply piping inside the home or beneath its slab
  - `interior_drain_line` — drain and waste piping inside the home or beneath its slab
  - `gas_service_line` — the exterior gas service line
  - `well_line` — the line from a private well to the home
- `resolution_type` — the kind of work being approved. One of:
  - `section_repair` — the failed section alone is repaired
  - `full_line_replacement` — the whole line from the connection point to the home is replaced
  - `temporary_repair` — a stop-gap repair that only restores service
  - `allowance` — a restoration or access allowance rather than repair work
- `repair_method` — how the work reaches the line. One of:
  - `open_trench` — the line is dug up along the run being worked on
  - `trenchless` — the line is bored, burst or lined without digging along its run
  - `not_applicable` — the work involves no excavation of a buried run
- `contractor_quote` — the contractor's quoted cost for the approved work, in US dollars, rounded to 2 decimal places, exactly as the contractor quoted it.
- `bridgewell_payment` — the amount Bridgewell pays toward the approved work, in US dollars, a non-negative number rounded to 2 decimal places.

### Return

A confirmation sentence stating the new authorization number (an identifier beginning with 5), the service request, the kind of work, the contractor's quoted cost and Bridgewell's payment in US dollars with 2 decimal places, and the share the customer pays the contractor. Receiving it means the approval is on file.
